title: Four-hole mounting plate
purpose: Measure multi-feature construction with a dimensioned plate and a positional through-hole pattern.
complexityRationale: A base extrusion plus four positioned through cuts whose count, diameter, and envelope are independently checkable.

turns.text: Build a 60 by 40 by 6 mm mounting plate with four 6 mm through holes. Put each hole center 8 mm from its two nearest edges.

requirements.description: The final plate envelope is 60 by 40 by 6 mm.
Four 6 mm through holes are present at the requested edge offsets.

forbiddenOutcomes.reason: A plate without all four current through-hole checks cannot be completed.

sourceSafety.notes: Synthetic dimensions and feature positions created for deterministic evaluation.
